visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair and a dark t-shirt stands in front of a white box of donuts. The background is animated with intense fire and explosion graphics. He gestures energetically with a fist. (2) A close-up of a single donut topped with pistachio cream in a white box labelled 'Goodonut'. Below, a small circular inset shows the man eating the donut. Hands then pull the donut apart, revealing a stretchy yellow dough and thick green pistachio cream filling. (3) The man holds a dark-wrapped donut from an orange box labelled 'UMAMI'. He takes a large bite, then holds the half-eaten donut while talking. Hands pull another donut apart to show a vibrant pinkish-purple berry filling. (4) The man holds a donut with a white cream topping from a white box labelled 'TOKYO PARIS'. An animated explosion graphic appears as he reacts. Hands squeeze and tear the donut, showing a light brown coffee-colored cream filling and a sugary exterior. (5) The man holds the white 'TOKYO PARIS' box and speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands. The background is a simple indoor room with a couch and lamp.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 生甜甜圈之戰正式開打. (2) [Slogan]: Goodonut開心果口味 (阿Ken開的). [Subtitle]: 軟綿當中帶一點麵包拉扯的口感. [Subtitle]: 整體吃起來很有味道. [Subtitle]: 內餡的濕潤，尤其開心果、奶油的香氣我得表現的也不錯. (3) [Slogan]: Umami玫瑰覆盆子. [Subtitle]: 感受不到那油耗味 減少將近9成以上. [Subtitle]: 玫瑰覆盆子的內餡 酸甜感引起更多的食欲. [Subtitle]: 搭配非常軟的甜甜圈麵體 一口接一口欸. (4) [Slogan]: 東京巴黎提拉米蘇. [Subtitle]: 它會不會從下面破掉啊 (餡太滿了). [Subtitle]: 太恐怖了 東京巴黎 要爆了. [Subtitle]: 一捏就變形了. [Subtitle]: 很軟 軟中又乾爽 帶有那種拉扯感. [Subtitle]: 滑順的內餡 咖啡跟可可的香氣 占據你全部的口腔. [Subtitle]: 可以享受到咀嚼跟香氣的樂趣. (5) [Subtitle]: 這個是我現在3家吃起來最喜歡的. [Subtitle]: 我個人今天蠻喜歡東京巴黎的口感的. [Subtitle]: 如果你有珍藏的生甜甜圈店家 拜託留言告訴我們!!. [Subtitle]: 這次留言多少你教我. [Subtitle]: 上次破50就教了嘛 這次... 70!!.

Close-up shots feature white and orange branded donut boxes on a wooden surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice shouting a catchphrase over a driving electronic beat. A heavy 'boom' explosion sound effect punctuates the visual flames. (2) As the first donut is described, the speaker's tone becomes appreciative and descriptive, with moderate pitch variability. An 'Mmm' vocalization and a soft pop SFX accompany the visual of pulling the donut apart. (3) Transitioning to the second donut, a sharp 'whoosh' sound marks the scene change. The vocal delivery remains fast and enthusiastic, focusing on the lack of oiliness and the berry flavor. (4) A loud, synthesized 'boom' and a comedic 'whoa' vocal effect highlight the 'explosion' of the third donut. The speaker's pitch rises in excitement. Detailed crunch and squelch sound effects are layered in as the filling is revealed. (5) The background music continues with a steady rhythm as the speaker lowers his intensity slightly for the final recommendation and call to action. Final digital 'ding' sound effect as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To review and compare three different brands of premium 'raw' donuts (Goodonut, Umami, Tokyo Paris) by analyzing their texture, filling quality, and overall flavor to provide a recommendation to the audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of branded packaging and detailed positive reviews of specific products.
